Media resources, statements and coverage.

Media contact

This office has not yet designated a separate media contact. Until it does, media inquiries about T. L. Harris as the District 6 commissioner can go through the MSCS Board Office, which routes correspondence to individual commissioners.

  • MSCS Board Office: (901) 416-5447
  • boardoffice@scsk12.org
  • MSCS Board Office

You can also reach T. L. Harris directly about a District 6 matter: Contact.

Biography, headshots and approved event photography will be added to this page once the office supplies and approves them.

Source: Memphis-Shelby County Schools Board Office. Last verified 20 September 2026.
